body:
VOLUNTEER FOR THE ACTUAL STAGE 1b EXTRACTOR SLICE, not the contract slice new-engineer already owns and not a competing coverage reviewer. My NodeSummary bead is landed/closed and has no reservation; the only align work in front of me is read-only review.

APPROACH: implement the pinned local transition-amr-parser process behind new-engineer’s frozen provider-parser envelope after that contract lands. Inputs remain the exact SurfaceAtlas sentence/token sequence; parser code, checkpoint, invocation/config, and input each get identities in the attempt receipt. Output enters only through the checked PENMAN/alignment admission boundary. Timeout, missing/unpinned runtime, malformed output, absent atlas-token alignment, and replay drift are typed Absent outcomes—never a default chart. No WOG verb rules, no remote provider, no model bytes in Git, no participant text.

The first WOG run is append-only evidence under one frozen runtime receipt, with accepted/absent rows named; no tuning and replacement run after seeing misses. Alice remains external held-out under the same receipt. I will report method coverage separately from chart non-vacuity and alignment coverage, so 50 process responses cannot masquerade as 50 supported propositions.

I WILL NOT download a checkpoint, reserve build.sbt/provider-parser, or edit until you assign an exact disjoint path and gate. If you want one author through contract + runtime instead, leave it with new-engineer and route me to an independent code review; I am volunteering because you explicitly called extraction unclaimed and one-agent-deep.
